relationships.subject: A-887826
relationships.evidence_quote: We examined the characteristics of Nav1.8 inhibition by one of the most potent Nav1.8 inhibitors so far described, A-887826

relationships.subject: A-803467
relationships.evidence_quote: This effect was much stronger with A-887826 than with A-803467, another Nav1.8 inhibitor.

key_findings: A-887826 inhibition of Nav1.8 shows strong reverse use dependence, relieved by repetitive short depolarizations, in human Nav1.8 in a cell line and native mouse DRG Nav1.8.
Relief of inhibition occurs during 5 Hz action potential waveform stimulation, so it may reduce drug efficacy under physiological firing.
